aiTitle: Cache headers for the image CDN (SHOP-230)

message.content: SHOP-230: product images are re-downloaded on every visit. Set proper cache headers on the image CDN.

content.text: Images are content-hashed already, so they can be immutable: Cache-Control public, max-age=31536000, immutable. The HTML stays no-cache. I also raised the CDN's origin rate limit, since the first deploy will refill every edge cache at once.

message.content: Check the hit ratio after deploy.

content.text: Edge hit ratio went from 61% to 97% within the hour, and origin egress dropped by about 80%.
